Class BigSet<T>

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.BigSet<T>
Type Parameters:
T - type of element stored in the set
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
BigNumberedSet
public abstract class BigSet<T> extends Object implements Iterable<T>
A custom implementation of a collection that does not allow duplicates which can hold up to BigArrayList.MAX_CAPACITY elements and which uses long integers to measure its size().
Author:
Stephen G. Ware
